name: publish-article
description: Researches a topic, drafts an article, and reviews it for quality before publishing

agents.name: topic-researcher
agents.prompt: Research the given topic and return structured source data

agents.name: article-writer
agents.prompt: Write a structured article from the research data

agents.name: quality-reviewer
agents.prompt: Review the article for clarity, accuracy, and structure. Return a score and verdict.
